Container.Name: super-productivity
Container.Overview:
Super Productivity is an open-source task planner and time tracker with daily planning, focus timers, and optional integrations.
This container serves the web app. Tasks are stored in each browser's local storage, not in the container's /config directory. Use the app's backup or optional sync features to preserve your tasks and access them from other devices. Export a backup before clearing browser data or changing the address you use to open the app.
Desktop and mobile apps are also available at https://super-productivity.com/download/
